a small promise, sealed for you

My Devaammaaaa,

 

Since 2nd December, you have been the softest, warmest part of my everyday. I promise to choose you again every single morning, to hold your hand through the ordinary days and the hard ones, to laugh at your jokes even the tenth time, and to never let distance or time make us feel far.

I promise to be your safe place, your loudest cheerleader, and your calmest peace — my mummy, my babyyy, my half, my wife, my everything.

Happy Girlfriend's Day, my love. This is only the beginning.
